name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based predictive input buffer with ten buffering stages.

stage.name: Buffer Stage
stage.description: 0 = Off, 1 = 2/2 ticks, 2 = 4/4 ticks, 3 = 8/8 ticks, 4 = 16/8 ticks, 5 = 32/16 ticks, 6 = 32/32 ticks, 7 = 64/32 ticks, 8 = 64/64 ticks, 9 = 128/64 ticks, 10 = 128/128 ticks (normal/wave).
